path_graph_local_support_counterexample.manuscript: J156-7-12 scans94,97-100; L1 explicit J156-7-02 scan20 lines96-98
path_graph_local_support_counterexample.model: Figures are all cliques of A'--A--B--B'; both orders are inclusion; M=L consists of singleton figures.
path_graph_local_support_counterexample.L1_scope: No strictness is inserted: a locus is an interior refinement of itself, since it has no proper nonempty sub-stratum.
path_graph_local_support_counterexample.conclusion: The relative complement formula remains false with At1-7, L1-3, Cspac, D, and AtSupp.
path_graph_local_support_counterexample.limitation: The model does not satisfy optional AtSupp1 absorption: closure({A'}) contains B. No refutation is claimed when that additional hypothesis is imposed.

naive_figure_pullback_counterexample.conclusion: Discarding only empty closed preimages does not produce a figure; discard empty open strata as an analyst's corrected construction.

lower_subfamily_At3_failure.family: all subsets of {0,1,2} of cardinality at most 2
lower_subfamily_At3_failure.conclusion: Sousat2 is essential; the manuscript itself adds it.
